entities.summary: The Hausa are the largest ethnic group in West Africa (80+ million). Their city-state tradition and trans-Saharan trade networks date to the 7th century. Intermarriage with Fulani pastoralists after the Sokoto Jihad (1804) created a dominant cultural bloc in northern Nigeria.
